basic.name: Mind is Might
basic.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of Dr. Ratio's ATK to a single target enemy.

skill.name: Intellectual Midwifery
skill.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of Dr. Ratio's ATK to a single target enemy.

ultimate.name: Syllogistic Paradox
ultimate.description_template:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of Dr. Ratio's ATK to a single target enemy and applies Wiseman's Folly. When Dr. Ratio's teammates attack a target afflicted with Wiseman's Folly, Dr. Ratio launches 1 instance of his Talent's Follow-Up ATK against this target.
Wiseman's Folly can be triggered for up to 2 times and only affects the most recent target of Dr. Ratio's Ultimate. This trigger count resets after Dr. Ratio's Ultimate is used.

talent.name: Cogito, Ergo Sum
talent.description_template: When using his Skill, Dr. Ratio has a 40% fixed chance of launching a Follow-Up ATK against his target for 1 time, dealing Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of Dr. Ratio's ATK. For each debuff the target enemy has, the fixed chance of launching Follow-Up ATK increases by 20%. If the target enemy is defeated before the Follow-Up ATK triggers, the Follow-Up ATK will be directed at a single random enemy instead.

technique.name: Mold of Idolatry
technique.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that Taunts nearby enemies, lasting for 10 second(s). After entering battle with enemies in this Special Dimension, there is a 100% base chance to reduce each single enemy target's SPD by 15% for 2 turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

2.name: Summation
2.description: When Dr. Ratio uses his Skill, for every debuff on the target, his CRIT Rate increases by 2.5% and CRIT DMG by 5%. This effect can stack up to 6 time(s).

4.name: Inference
4.description: When Skill is used to attack an enemy target, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the attacked enemy target's Effect RES by 10% for 2 turn(s).

6.name: Deduction
6.description: When dealing DMG to a target that has 3 or more debuff(s), for each debuff the target has, the DMG dealt by Dr. Ratio to this target increases by 10%, up to a maximum increase of 50%.

eidolons.name: Pride Comes Before a Fall
eidolons.description: The maximum stackable count for the Trace "Summation" increases by 4. When a battle begins, immediately obtains 4 stacks of Summation. Needs to unlock Summation first.

eidolons.name: The Divine Is in the Details
eidolons.description: When his Talent's Follow-Up ATK hits a target, for every debuff the target has, deals Imaginary Additional DMG equal to 20% of Dr. Ratio's ATK. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of 4 time(s) during each Follow-Up ATK.

eidolons.name: Know Thyself
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Ignorance Is Blight
eidolons.description: When triggering the Talent, additionally regenerates 15 Energy for Dr. Ratio.

eidolons.name: Sic Itus Ad Astra
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Vincit Omnia Veritas
eidolons.description: Additionally increases the trigger count for "Wiseman's Folly" by 1. The DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-Up ATK increases by 50%.
